youtube_media.title: EVW 25 Picks | Some Huge Implications For Future Battles
youtube_media.summary:
East vs West 25 is one of the most stacked cards we've seen in a long time. 
Some of these matches could completely reshape the rankings, create new title contenders, and even influence my own path in the months ahead.
In this video, I'm breaking down every match on the card, explaining what I think will happen, why I think it happens, and which matches I believe will have the biggest impact on the future of professional armwrestling.
Whether you agree with my picks or think I'm completely wrong, I want to hear your predictions in the comments.

Who do you think walks away with the biggest win of the night?
